summary: This stage executed a thorough two-arm replication of Paper P, comparing code-faithful execution (Arm C) with paper-faithful equations (Arm P). The run downloaded MUSE vectors, performed hard-debiasing and supervised alignments, and successfully reproduced multiple exact anchors including ES Original MWEAT (3.6918), ES Shift/Hybrid Ori (0.3090), cos(d_PCA, d_g) (0.3885), classifier accuracies (0.9140 / 0.8258), and word-pair analogy gap (0.4866). It uncovered several important discrepancies, discovering that Table 1 word similarity is MUSE's Spearman rho rather than Pearson, confirming that the paper's LDA accuracies came from LinearSVC, and proving that De-Align cannot reduce bias under orthogonal alignment. However, it accepted the mitigation's MWEAT reduction at face value without identifying the algebraic circularity of the shift or the lack of informativeness in the permutation p-values, and falsely claimed that the paper's text contradicts its own MWEAT formula.
